# Generated by `dist` (cargo-dist); do not edit by hand.
#
# The release workflow publishes a *complete* formula — version and every sha256 —
# as the `tropism.rb` asset on the GitHub release. `.github/workflows/homebrew-formula.yml`
# prepends this header to that asset and opens an auto-merging pull request, so the
# version and the checksums always arrive in the same commit.
#
# That is why `make release` does not touch this file. A hand-bumped version would
# name tarballs that do not exist yet, and every `brew install` between the bump and
# the end of the build would fail on a checksum mismatch.
#
# The tap is this repository rather than a separate `homebrew-tropism` repo, so the
# tap command needs an explicit URL:
#
#   brew tap grahambrooks/tropism https://github.com/grahambrooks/tropism
#   brew install grahambrooks/tropism/tropism
